firm_data.firm_description: Harris Beach Murtha Cullina PLLC is a full-service law firm providing legal and professional services to clients across New York state, as well as nationally and internationally. The firm has grown to 250 attorneys across 17 locations.
notable_facts: The firm was formed through the combination of Harris Beach PLLC and Murtha Cullina LLP.
Harris Beach is ranked as a BTI Elite law firm based on interviews of corporate counsel.

ai_contact.name: Brendan M. Palfreyman
ai_contact.ai_notes: The firm launched an Artificial Intelligence Industry Team to assist clients with navigating the legal, ethical, regulatory and business challenges raised by AI. The team is comprised of more than a dozen attorneys and is led by Brendan M. Palfreyman, Timothy J. Plunkett, and Alan M. Winchester.

email.subject: AI for Harris Beach Murtha Cullina, built for firms scaling nationally
email.body:
Hi there,

Your AI Industry Team, led by Brendan Palfreyman and Timothy Plunkett, is already positioning Harris Beach Murtha Cullina ahead of peers on one of the biggest client demands right now. That forward momentum is exactly what caught our attention.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of growing practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by Pittsford to share how ex-lawyers like us are helping similar firms compete and scale across multiple locations.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
